scope: One exposed-development transfer diagnostic at a previously reviewed source frame. This does not select a policy threshold or certify candidate identity, per-anchor truth, calibrated decisions, continuous motion, source independence, or a Foam-upper classifier.

geometry.padding: Symmetric 9-row invalid padding; masked pixels become RGB normalization mean in the unchanged encoder. No native crop resize before the one 228-to-224 encoder transform.
geometry.sampling: Unchanged native X578 and native ±12 strip offsets, common visible/glare-free columns across query and all three references, minimum 8 columns. Query weights use actual 228 edge; reference weights retain original 104 edge.
geometry.ablation: Same geometry, masks, token lattice and strips for full/local. Local retains only native 25x25 anchor context; no crop enlargement.
geometry.scope: Native camera scale and token footprint differ across sources; transfer statistics do not calibrate exact coordinates or isolate all model-distribution effects.

anchor_truth: UNREVIEWED_ANCHOR for every sampled row, including those within the reviewed range. The reply establishes interval containment only. Floor/ceil coverage retains endpoint uncertainty instead of choosing a convenient centre.
reference_bank: Original sample4 interface/structure/internal-texture exemplars unchanged; regional contexts, not pure masks. No Foam-upper prototype exists.
source_overlap: Different source bytes, exposed development; episode independence and untouched evaluation are not established. No new sample3 access.
stages: Validate pinned source/bank/masks and native source-crop identity.
13 geometry controls passed before scoring; encoder-through-pixel 228-square control must pass before all real queries.
Execute the complete 35-anchor full/local roster once, retain every status and all three role scores.
interpretation: Report category preferences, raw similarities, availability and token overlap for all anchors. Neither a favourable anchor nor a range average is a physical positive, candidate selector or operating point. All-anchor inability to meet the fixed local preference condition may delimit this frozen transfer only; continuous native accuracy remains unassessed.
stop: Stop after this fixed complete diagnostic, or a pin/geometry/pixel-control/resource failure. Do not replace source, tune crop/scale/offsets/bank/margin or rerun with favourable choices. Preserve limits and choose the next design step through current owners.
retention: Keep the frozen manifest and compact full readout; reuse existing images/references/model. Discard token maps, unused temporary files and scratch metadata.
